correctness.rationale: The natural-scale time-change and interval-exit excursion define independent renewal cycles with exponential moments. Direct integration of killed Brownian Green kernels proves the excursion duration and occupation mean; an explicitly checked C1 Dirichlet solution with u(x0)=u(±L)=0 makes H-p tau an Itô stochastic integral. Its quadratic expectation is exactly twice the Green energy. Standard renewal-reward CLT plus bounded-domain exponential moments yield the CLT and scaled variance convergence. Exact rational integration gives the closed symmetric coefficient and direct algebra proves strict monotonicity of the matched-frequency ratio. The standalone checker replays 300 rational/integral/finite-difference checks. Independent scientific validation not performed.

value.rationale: The source only quantifies the asymptotic occupation fraction, leaving its finite-observation-time resolution undetermined. Its Gaussian variance controls uncertainty in positive-side occupancy and distinguishes spatial-triggered and memoryless reset protocols at matched physical event frequency, with an exact robust ratio from 1/3 to the nonattained 3/4 boundary. This is a motivated quantitative dynamic invariant requiring a nontrivial stopped-excursion covariance, not a cosmetic relabeling or arbitrarily selected subcase. The full reset-location quadrature supplies further direct observability.
